title: Vallée on Ransone's NRO satellite work

plain: In the late 1970s in Houston, a woman named Valerie Ransone was reportedly doing some kind of work for the NRO, the US agency that runs spy satellites, and talked about it with the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée. An unnamed researcher guest tells Michels this from Vallée's published journals, Forbidden Science, saying Vallée 'spoke with her back in that late '70s time and she was doing some sort of work for the NRO.' It matters to the guest because it would tie Ransone to secret satellite work in the same years she crossed paths with a leading UFO researcher.
